title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to edit and run playbooks could read or…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where an authenticated user with permission to edit and run playbooks can access or modify persisted playbook run data beyond their authorized scope. This includes sensitive data such as playbook inputs, outputs, secrets, and intermediate results. The flaw arises because the playbook automation APIs do not enforce data operation restrictions tied to the active playbook run. This can lead to unauthorized data disclosure and corruption of playbook run results.
